every_refusal_is_measured: Each family was probed by THIS client at THIS moment. A refusal here is a fact about this request, never evidence that a family has no Greater Fort Lauderdale property, and never inherited from an earlier order.
every_walk_is_bounded: Each family carries a request cap of 150.
